_note: Copy to config.json. Secrets stay in env vars, referenced as env:NAME. Extra _note keys are ignored.

pools._note: Points at a LIVE mainnet pool so `npm run check` works the moment you copy this file — run it once to see real output, then swap in your own pool address, reference feed(s) and quoting authority. mode=shadow + dryRun means nothing is ever signed.
pools.name: jitosol-sol-6rK6

refs._note: Third-party venue oracle for JitoSOL/SOL: u64 mid at offset 424, scale 1e-10. Both mints are 9dp so ui == atom ratio here.

quoteAuthority._note: The quoting key(s) you consider legitimate — `npm run check` prints the pool's current one. If omitted, whatever key is present at boot becomes the baseline; always pin it before arming.

midDeviation._note: Pause when the pool's pushed mid is this far off the reference. Starting points by asset class are in README.md.

drawdown._note: Pause if pool equity (marked at the reference price) falls this far below its window maximum. 64800000ms = 18h. pauseOnBreach=false means this budget ALERTS rather than pausing — a false pause stops your pool quoting, so opt in only after a shadow period.
